body:
Let a design run check a set of element operations without asking the human. Solace applies them to a copy and checks the result exactly as `design propose` does (D-241 point 3), saves nothing, and asks no question. It replies either with the first refusal, naming the element, or with a short outline of what was added, removed, moved and changed. Today a mistake only shows up as a refused proposal, and the agent has to propose again and wait.

## Done when

- A valid check saves nothing and leaves the run with no new question.
- An invalid check returns the same refusal `design propose` would give (`E7033` / `E7001`, naming the element).
- The run's commands, help and Spec 15's design run paragraph cover it.

## Suggested (cursory, not prescriptive)

- Share one apply-and-validate path with `design propose`, so the two can't disagree.
title: design: check a proposal first
